title: Huly closing call to action
description: Near-black closing band: a dark watch face drawn in CSS with an ember arc and a blue arc that sway, a ticking second hand and a dim logo, crossed by a warm halftone light streak from the left and a cool one leaving to the lower right. A gradient headline and two pills sit beside it (stacked and centred on phones).
notes: dark by default (tone="dark" adds the dark class); the light streaks need a dark backdrop
the arcs and second hand animate in CSS, off under reduced motion; no JavaScript
pairs with huly-footer, which uses the same background
name: huly-cta

props.name: secondary
props.type: { label: string; href: string; icon?: ReactNode; }
props.description: the dark outline pill, with an optional icon

props.name: logo
props.description: mark set large and dim on the watch face

props.name: tone
props.description: dark forces the dark colours (as on the original); inherit follows the page
